scaling: no term applies a scale in this task: every value is in SI units as defined below. The graph's own normaliser absorbs the rest.
note: concatenated in this order, single frame, no history. Both policies take this exact vector. The policy ONNX includes the observation normaliser (Sub/Div at the head), so feed it RAW values.

terms.name: base_ang_vel
terms.definition: pelvis angular velocity in the pelvis frame, rad/s (gyro)

terms.name: projected_gravity
terms.definition: unit gravity vector expressed in the pelvis frame

terms.name: command
terms.definition: commanded twist (vx, vy, wz) in the pelvis frame; ZERO while the recovery policy holds control

terms.name: phase
terms.definition: (sin, cos) of 2*pi*((t mod period)/period), an OPEN-LOOP clock on time since start, not synchronised to the actual gait; forced to (0, 0) whenever norm(command) < 0.1, which is the case throughout a handover

terms.name: joint_pos
terms.definition: q - default_pos, rad, natural joint order (see plant.joints)

terms.name: actions
terms.definition: the RAW action vector output by whichever policy acted last step, before action_scale/action_offset are applied; zero on the first step

at_handover: command the recovery policy a zero twist. The labels the estimator was trained on were produced that way; a non-zero command invalidates them.
